2.260.1
MapLegend.Name
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The MapLegend.Name attribute specifies a name for a MapLegend. This attribute MUST be specified.
The value of this attribute MUST be a case-sensitive String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1) that is a
CLS-compliant identifier [UTR15].
Following is the parent element of the MapLegend.Name attribute.
Parent elements
MapLegend
The following is the XML Schema definition of the MapLegend.Name attribute.
 <xsd:attribute name="Name" type="xsd:normalizedString" use="required" />
